name: Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés

submission.postalAddress: CNIL - Service des Plaintes, 3 Place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris, France

procedural.notes: The CNIL requires complaints to be drafted in French ("être rédigée en langue française"). Complaints can be filed online via the cnil.fr plaintes portal (account creation required) or by post to the Service des Plaintes address. The CNIL has actively enforced ePrivacy Article 5(3) cookie/consent obligations (cookie banner fines under the CNIL recommendation of October 2020).
